title: 250 YEARS OF CELEBRATION; 400 YEARS OF SWEAT EQUITY!

sense.text:
“I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men”. This is not only prophecy written down; it is the way it is done. America deals with our people the way you hide insects or rodents when company comes: sweep the dirt into the closet, push it up under the rug. America puts out a facade that it is about justice and righteous judgment, and if the world went past that veneer into the ghettos it would ask: how are you going to come over to our land and tell us about democracy and liberty, and look how you deal with the people who built this damn country? So they hide us in the corners.

The remembrance of what happened to us is made to cease from before men. Our story is not told in the schools, not told on television, and they do not want us to have newspapers to tell the world what we are going through. When we bring it up, they turn it around: stop that crying, stop that hollering, why are you always complaining? A total dismissal of our pain and anguish. They abuse the hell out of us, hide us, and give us just enough dope to rejoice and say we are okay.

The celebrating of the 4th of July, the 4th of you lied, is a covering for a sick mind. Under all the celebration, how many more Sandra Blands, how many more Rasheem Carters, how many dead brothers, even shot by ourselves? It does not have to be Esau, because the mindset we have against each other came from them: white men with black bodies, the mind inside the body just like the oppressor.

They celebrate 250 years since 1776, their independence from their brothers, Great Britain. But 400 years of sweat equity is longer than 250 years: we were slaving and toiling before this place even became America, catching total abuse from the moment we were dragged off the ships. It has never been a good day for us. If we were not here they would have nothing to celebrate. America is more prosperous after slavery, exploiting us, than it was in slavery, because in physical slavery we still had our minds and fought to be free. So they indoctrinated us to be willing slaves, to enslave ourselves and do evil to each other, while the merchants and the nations move into our neighborhoods and drain every dollar we work for on the plantation. If we try to do anything for ourselves, they bomb us, set us up and destroy us, because that is not our place. And we are so dumb and deaf and blind we celebrate with them in a red, white and blue hat, while they look at us and say: you are the reason we are having such a good time.

“And there appeared another wonder in heaven; and behold a great red dragon”. The red dragon is red people, a red nation. Its heads are the kingdoms that came one after another: Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Russia and Great Britain. Out of that seventh head, Great Britain, came America, and that is what is being celebrated: 250 years of being broken away from Great Britain.

Why would the Most High even call it red if it was not talking about them? The Most High has their card. They are the red nation, and they fit the prophecies of this Bible.

“And the woman which thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth.” The woman is the eighth head that came from the seven: America, which broke away from Great Britain. Greece, Rome, Spain and France are four; Germany is five, Russia six, Great Britain seven; and from that seventh head came America, the eighth.

The Lord had to explain this to John because the eighth head was a mystery to him and to everybody else. The other seven were back there under different names, but the eighth head did not exist in actuality. It existed in the spirit, in prophecy, but it did not have a physical footprint on the earth. Christ was revealing it to him.

That great city is America, which reigneth, which rules over the kings of the earth. America is ruling over everybody, and that is who this is describing. She made the nations drunk with the wine of her fornication: that is what their democracy and their foreign policy are about, making the nations drunk with weapons and with the lies of their Christian programs, indoctrinating and subjugating all the nations to follow their dictate.

“So he carried me away in the spirit into the wilderness: and I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast”. That is what John was in mystery over: what is this beast he sees? The woman is somewhat different from the beast she is sitting on: she sits upon a red beast. The eighth head rode upon the seven heads, and that is why the picture of the heads rightly draws the eighth in a different colour from the seven. This chapter is going into America, and no Christian is ever going to tell you that.

“full of names of blasphemy”: full of lies. America is full of lies and blasphemy. They call themselves Christians and they call themselves Jews and they are neither. They lied on us: we are the real Jews that they dragged over here and subjugated into all kinds of evil. They came over here and murdered the Native Americans, the brothers and sisters who were in this country, damn near wiped out Gad and Reuben, and then talk about justice.

“having seven heads and ten horns”. Horns mean power. America extracts its power from these ten: they are set up to fortify the endeavours of the main beast, America. That is NATO, the G20 and the rest. Even though they add different names and cut it up and divide it, they fit the prophecies of this Bible.

“And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls”. She had rubies, diamonds and riches; she was decked out because she stole the riches of the other nations. She robbed all the nations, and that is why she is “that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth.”

“having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication”: this place is loaded with every kind of abomination and filthiness.

“And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS”. Mystery means: who is it? It had to be said that way, especially at that time, because nobody knew about this eighth head that has come up now. It was in the spiritual prophecy of what was coming, and that is why John was able to write it: Christ showed it to him.

precepts.why:
“For the mystery of iniquity”: the mystery of sin. Iniquity means sin. So the question is: who is the devil, who is the evil one, who is that man of sin? It is a mystery, meaning nobody is pointing directly at him.

That is the mystery written on the forehead of the woman. The Bible goes on to clear it up: Isaiah calls him by name, Lucifer, fallen from heaven, and Paul says that man of sin has to be revealed. Who is he? The eighth head, the woman sitting on the beast.

sense.text:
“How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning!” You are the devil. This chapter of Isaiah is future prophecy of the destruction of this very kingdom we are in, spoken in the past tense: how art thou fallen from heaven, from your rulership. Thou is you: the Bible is pointing at him, and it explains how it is going to be done.

Lucifer means light bearer. They told everybody they are the bright star of wisdom, the bright star of education, the bright star of justice: we are the ones with the democracy; you want justice and judgment, come to us. That is a complete lie, the facade they put on while hiding the evil they have done to us. That is what the so-called Lady of Liberty, the Statue of Liberty, is. These witches make all these symbols and statues up and know what they are doing, while the poor blind negro does not know what is going on.

“how art thou cut down to the ground”: the Most High is showing in the past tense that they are going to be destroyed. “which didst weaken the nations”: with bombs and Christianity and democracy and lies. That is how they got all the nations to serve them and rule over them; that is the beast that reigneth over the earth, because the nations no longer have the strength to fight against it.

This is the mystery revealed, and the mystery is Esau. You are the devil, the man of sin, the evil one, the 666, the dragon.

“For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven”: airplanes and space travel. That is this beast. “I will exalt my throne above the stars of God”: the Most High said we are to dwell on this earth, and he says, No, Lord, I am going beyond your boundaries, I am putting things out there in outer space, I go boldly where no man has gone before, because I am God. That is how he thinks, and the Most High has him thinking that way.

“I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation”. Who is the congregation? The Lord’s people. In addition to going out into the heavens, he sits upon the mount of God’s congregation in captivity: I am going to bewilder them, bewitch them, trick them, lie to them, give them Christianity and these evil holidays, and completely psych them out so they think the Bible is not talking about them. He sits upon the Israelites, on our thinking and our mentality, and keeps us in ignorance and evil and sin and the evil we do to each other.

“in the sides of the north”: this hemisphere where we are, the north country, North America. That is where he sits on us, and it is from that same land of the north that the Most High is going to bring us out.
“Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.” Brought down to destruction. You are not going to stop your downfall.

“They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee”. To look narrowly at somebody is to squint. Even in the spirit, it means taking the rose-coloured glasses out of your view of who these people are and who they tell you they are: removing the facade, the glitz and glamour, the imagery everybody goes crazy over (they are so handsome, the white woman and her pretty blonde hair), and seeing exactly who he is, really examining him.

What is going to cause them to see him? The Bible. The Bible is going to reveal who these people really are, and people will start to recognize: you are not Paul, you are not James, not John, Peter or Matthew; you are the devil the Bible speaks of. They that see Esau shall narrowly look upon him, “and consider thee”. Consider means: hold it, wait a minute, do you realize what we are dealing with? Remove all the BS and see what we are really dealing with.

“saying, Is this the man”: the man of sin. That is where the chapter is going, and that is the mystery: everybody acts as if they do not know who he is. And it says the man: Lucifer is a man.

“Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms”: the man that made everybody afraid, that reigned over the whole earth as it says in Revelation, that made all the nations drink of the wine. It is all saying the same thing. He shook kingdoms by dropping bombs on them, coming into another man’s land and taking him out of it, as Trump did to Maduro, while everybody just stands by. That is the terror. The Bible is unfolding and people act as if it is not saying anything, and the ones playing with this Bible are going to burn for that.

“That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof”. He destroyed the air, destroyed the water, destroyed the people’s minds. A man is born with a penis and testicles, a woman with a vagina and breasts, and still they are confused. The people’s minds are messed up and the cities are messed up: that is what we are dealing with now.

That is why the Bible says folly is set in great dignity: a fool is running this planet and everything is messed up. When the righteous are in authority the people rejoice, but when the wicked bear rule the people mourn. We are living in hell.

precepts.why:
Jeremiah was opened to pull out that word north: in the sides of the north is where he is sitting on us. “Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that it shall no more be said, The Lord liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt”. That is still said now, still in the news and on people’s minds. The problem is the way they sat on us: they sat on our mentality so well that the world does not know the Bible is talking about us. That is how well they hid us. They manufactured a people called Jews and said these are the people the Bible is talking about. A total lie. You are the Jews; you are the Israelites.

Something beyond galactic has to happen to make us stop talking about how the Lord delivered us from ancient Egypt: the Red Sea, the destruction, the ten plagues. It has to be so spectacular, so magnificent and so marvelous that it makes you stop talking about that, and that is when he delivers us from here. This is what the people are going to say instead: “But, The Lord liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north”.

The land of the north is the same place where we are being oppressed, what Isaiah calls the sides of the north. When that happens, it is going to shake up everything.

Another scripture literally says the north country. “Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that they shall no more say, The Lord liveth, which brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt”. Everybody still talks like that, about when we were in Egypt, because the Lord has not made his grand debut yet, his second debut to take us out of here.

This is what they are going to say: “The Lord liveth, which brought up and which led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country”. The Most High is coming back to take us home, from the north country.

That is the sides of the north in Isaiah: the north country, North America, where this beast sits upon the Israelites and keeps them in ignorance and evil and sin. When the deliverance written in Psalms 91 gets to rolling, nobody will think about Egypt at all; it will make everything before it look like nothing.

sense.text:
This is what is going to be even more spectacular, what will make everybody forget about ancient Egypt. “Then shall the righteous man stand in great boldness”. That is what we are being taught now: to be bold among our enemies, who are literally praying for us to remain slaves and do nothing for ourselves, so they can keep exploiting and dominating us. In the middle of that psychological tyranny and physical tyranny, the Most High says we are still going to stand in great boldness.

“before the face of such as have afflicted him”: we, the righteous man, are going to stand before the face of the enemies who afflicted us. In their mind there is no way we are supposed to be standing up: we afflicted them and meant to keep them in the corners, hidden, scattered into corners as Deuteronomy says. We were not brought over here for anything but to be their slaves. They know that because they know our Bible. Just stay in your place, that is the only reason we brought you here: you are the fuel, the burden bearers of the real Americans. Their celebration is celebrating having dominated us for 250 years.

So when we stand up, in their mind it is: you are uppity, what do you mean trying to get out of your place, you should love being under me. He even calls it a sickness when you try to get away from him: drapetomania, the sickness of a so-called negro or slave who seeks freedom from good old master. As if he is better off being whipped, burned, raped, castrated, lynched, hung and tortured, and something is wrong with him mentally for wanting to get away from such a vile snake. That is the arrogance of these demons.

“and made no account of his labours”: they don’t give a damn about all the work we did, beyond 250 years. Made no account of it. The negro with the top hat and the stripes on his head, dancing and jumping up and down: what is he celebrating? In 1776 he was still in chains. The Statue of Liberty in New York Harbor has chains at her feet, a symbol that the lady of liberty broke away from the grip of Britain, and those coming through Ellis Island look to her as their symbol. They understand breaking away for themselves, but we cannot want that for ourselves, while we are in slavery under this very system.

“When they see it, they shall be troubled with terrible fear”. When our enemies see us stand up in great boldness they shall be shaken, because they know who they have in captivity, who they have in slavery. The point is for you not to know who you are, but they know who you are. As long as you don’t know who you are, you will subject yourself to inferior behaviour and to mediocrity in your walk, your aspirations and your endeavours; you will shortchange yourself, thinking no more of yourself than they taught you to think.

So the terrible fear is you breaking out of that sickness and recognizing who you truly are. When you do that, the world is going to catch hell, because they say it means the God of these people is soon to come. That is what they are praying against today, celebrating to make sure we stay dominated. Our rise tells them we expect a deliverer: we expect Christ to come back, the deliverance and saving from the hand of our enemies and all that hate us. Once we start looking for that, they can’t buy us off; we know our God is coming to kick their ass. That is why they are acting up the way they are: they are having a fit that the Israelites are waking up.

“and shall be amazed at the strangeness of his salvation”. Amazed means your mind is blown. The strangeness of the Lord’s salvation is not only the people he is going to save but how he is going to do it. It is written in the Psalms read at the opening: a thousand shall fall at thy side and ten thousand at thy right hand, but it shall not come nigh thee; only with thine eyes shalt thou behold it. Being delivered and seeing the destruction of your enemies with your own eyes: that is the strangeness of his salvation.

“so far beyond all that they looked for.” When the chariots do their maneuvers and chase the colonels and admirals flying around trying to figure out what is going on in outer space, the angels chase them and terrorize them: I came in the ship with you, sat on the seat beside you, then I got outside and became bigger than the earth; go back to NASA headquarters and tell them that. No propulsion, no propellers, no jet, and they don’t understand how it moves. One of the astronauts said it: do you think those beings need all that equipment in Florida to get two men up there on a bicycle? What they saw made the whole NASA program look like a bicycle. So they debrief them and will not let them talk, because they might say: they’re black. That is the strangeness of his salvation, and that is what will make everybody forget about Egypt.

precepts.why:
The strangeness of his salvation is the power of how these angels move: they move with thought. “And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went”. That is the chariots. Everywhere the spirit went, the chariots were there.

We were in Liberia a little while ago, and Liberia is a long way from here. Our spirit can put a thought in our mind (remember when we were in Liberia and saw such and such) and as fast as you thought about it, you could be there. That is the speed they move at: the speed of thought, instantly. What could you do against the strangeness of that kind of salvation? Wherever the spirit of the angels was to go, they are there already. They don’t need jet fuel or propulsion; they fly and leave no sound, the wind undisturbed, no turbulence. They can’t do a damn thing with those angels.

“and they turned not when they went”: they did not have to aim themselves. They just be, and they are there. You can’t do anything with that.

Zechariah shows the size and power of a chariot, to show the magnificence of what Wisdom of Solomon is speaking of. “Then I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a flying roll.” The Lord asks him, “What seest thou?”, and he answers, “I see a flying roll; the length thereof is twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof ten cubits.” He is giving the size of it: a pretty sizeable ship. And it had to be huge. A billboard’s words look close from the ground, but up close the letters are fifteen or twenty feet high; Zechariah could look up and read what was written on this thing.

“This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth”: the Lord saying, I am going to send a chariot to terrorize my enemies; this is the curse I send to destroy the nations. Written on one side of the ship: “every one that stealeth shall be cut off as on this side according to it”. On the other side: “every one that sweareth shall be cut off as on that side according to it.”

America is a major thief, and she is an amazing liar, swearing she is the Israelites, the Jews, putting In God We Trust on the money while the very ground the courts sit on is stolen property. “I will bring it forth, saith the Lord of hosts, and it shall enter into the house of the thief”: the chariots that move at the speed of thought enter the house of the thief, America. That is why they are complaining about them now and talking about Star Wars: they keep popping up whenever they want, showing up when they feel like it.

“and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name”: those that lied on the Bible with their Christian garbage. You took my Bible, put your nasty hands on it and told the nations the Bible was about you, while my children of Israel suffer under your brutality. “and it shall remain in the midst of his house”: they can’t get rid of them. “and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof”: fire and brimstone destruction. That is what those chariots represent, and they know it. This place has got to burn.

sense.text:
“Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first”. Paul is telling the Israelites: that day shall not come except the Israelites go into complete captivity, like where we are now. All of this is prophesied, and our deliverance is prophesied too.

“and that man of sin be revealed”: there is the mystery again. They shall take a good look at him, narrowly look upon him as Isaiah says, consider him, and recognize: wait a minute, this man is the devil the Bible speaks of. “the son of perdition”: the son of hell, the son of destruction. Perdition means destruction. He was made to be destroyed by God; he is the vessel of God’s wrath and cannot get out of it. Keep that word in mind, because it comes again in Revelation 17.

“Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God”: he opposes God, he opposes the Bible, he opposes all righteousness. He is what Paul called Elymas the sorcerer in Acts 13: the child of the devil, the enemy of all righteousness.

“or that is worshipped”. What is a negro doing in a top hat with stars and stripes on his forehead? When they marked their first year of independence he was a slave, and nobody thought about getting him out of slavery. After slavery came Jim Crow and the black codes, everything levied against us to make sure we never prosper.

“so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God”: he pretended to be God. He created the churches, built the big monuments with their stained glass windows, put that big ugly statue up over Rio de Janeiro. “shewing himself that he is God”: he made everybody think he is God, the bright star of wisdom, the bright star of justice. It is all saying the same thing: Lucifer.

“Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things? And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.” His time to be revealed is today. He is being revealed now.

“For the mystery of iniquity doth already work”: the mystery of iniquity is that man of sin, Lucifer. Doth already work means he was already in power. That was the time of Rome: Esau was ruling over the Israelites in Thessalonica as the Romans. Paul was letting them know who the devil was, because he is already ruling over us. Paul knew that.

“only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.” Only the Lord, who now allows him to continue to rule, will let him rule; when their time is up, they are done. The sand is running out of the hourglass, and every so-called negro and Israelite Hispanic tied up with them goes down when they go down.

Back to the seven heads: Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Russia and Britain, and from that seventh head the eighth, America. “MYSTERY”: that word is how all of this was brought up. Who is it, what are you talking about? It was a mystery then, because this beast did not even physically exist when it was written.

“BABYLON THE GREAT”: Babylon, Babel, the land of great lies, the land of confusion. “THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS”: the whorehouse. America has all the nations in bed with her and makes them follow her ways. If you don’t accept America’s ways, her foreign policies and political agendas, they cut your money off, cut your food off, put embargoes against you and sanction you, so you can’t even sell your own goods, the way they tell them over by the Strait of Hormuz they can’t move oil. What other country can do that, or has done that? Nobody. Only this beast.

“AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH”: the worst abominations of all times are right here. The abominations are so magnificent and the sickness so pervasive that the people subject to them think they are in heaven. That is a hell of a drug. We are literally drowning in abominations, and the microwave of the filthy spirits has zapped our brains into thinking this is utopia. That is divine sickness, almost.

“And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints”: America drank our blood in captivity, in robberies and rapes and castrations, slavery, murder, all of it. “and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus”: they also killed the martyrs of Jesus, our people, a lot of them trying to do right, and they knocked them off.

“and when I saw her, I wondered with great admiration”: John does not see this beast in full existence, but he is getting the understanding of it in a spiritual sense. When this thing comes, it is going to be crazy; that is what the writer wants the reader to understand.

“And the angel said unto me, Wherefore didst thou marvel?” John, why are you marveling, why are you bugging out? Don’t worry, I got you. “I will tell thee the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her, which hath the seven heads and ten horns”: I will tell you about the eighth head, America, the woman, and I will also tell you about the seven that carried her. This eighth head has the seven heads in her wings, so to speak, and the ten horns.

“The beast that thou sawest was, and is not”: the beast you saw, John, that you are marveling over, was in your vision, but it is not in your time; it is not in existence yet. That is why it is drawn in a different colour from the seven. John is writing it and bugging out at what Christ is showing him, like Habakkuk, who got sick and dizzy and said, let me be asleep when that time comes, this is too much for me. Christ told him, Don’t worry about that, I got you.

It is the same thing said in Isaiah: they have to look narrowly upon him to find out who he really is. And in Thessalonians: the mystery of iniquity, that man of sin, has to be revealed; if he is not revealed, he remains a mystery. The mystery is getting ready to be cleared up: the Most High is having it broken down to John through Christ.

“and shall ascend out of the bottomless pit”: it is a future prophecy. The bottomless pit is Europe, Britain and all of them: it shall ascend from them, come from them. “and go into perdition”: the same word as the son of perdition in Thessalonians, letting you know this devil is who we are reading about, the same thing our people are jumping up and down celebrating.

“and they that dwell on the earth shall wonder, whose names were not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, when they behold the beast that was, and is not, and yet is.” We are here now, today, beholding the beast that was in John’s vision, and was not yet in John’s time. And yet is: yet means it is going to come later, as the Lord said he will yet choose Israel. This beast was coming.
“And here is the mind which hath wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sitteth.” Seven mountains means seven governments.

“And there are seven kings”: rulership, which is why they have crowns. “five are fallen”: all of them except Rome. Rome had dominated everybody, so Greece was not in power, Spain was not in power, France, Germany and Russia were not in power: there are the five. “and one is”: that is Rome, the one that had John on the isle of Patmos. “and the other is not yet come; and when he cometh, he must continue a short space”: that was Great Britain, coming along afterwards.

“And the beast that was, and is not”: the beast John was marveling over, not in his time, not in existence. “even he is the eighth, and is of the seven”: America is of Great Britain and the rest of the seven heads. “and goeth into perdition”: there it is again, into destruction. This kingdom is going to be destroyed, and there is no getting out of it.

That is the 250 years of celebration: them celebrating the continuance of their existence as America since 1776. And 400 years of sweat equity is us working to maintain it, blindfolded, like slaves in the bottom of a ship rowing to keep the ship moving. We are the workhorse, and they want to keep us in corners and don’t want anybody to know it.

Our enemies moved against us because they knew they had the green light to do so: we had broken God’s laws. They studied to know that. As long as they keep us in sin and evil (debauchery, covetousness, lies, stealing, fornication, these dumb holidays) the Lord will not be with us, and our enemies have free rein to move against us. They even say it in their prayers.

“for the accuser of our brethren is cast down”. Who is the accuser? Esau, accusing our brethren, our people. “which accused them before our God day and night”: they are praying day and night, saying: Listen, the Israelites are in sin. We have them sleeping in adultery, we have them on dope, getting drunk, celebrating Christmas and the 4th of July. These are your people, Lord, and look at them. That is them accusing us before our Father.

It is like somebody coming to your parents and saying: your daughter isn’t worth anything, your son isn’t worth anything, look what they are doing, and you still want to give them this and that, still want to bless them and hold out your hand to help them. Meanwhile that same somebody set them up to do it. That is what the accuser of our brethren did.

That is why they put us in these debaucherous situations: operant conditioning, training the mind and the behaviour through repetition. Then they throw the rock and hide their hand, so it seems they had nothing to do with it. They gave us the opportunity to abort our children and influenced it through social media and pornography, so they have a hand in it, and the Most High is going to deal with them for that. We just have to get our minds right and repent.

This is what the nations know: a biblical example of what the history shows. Achior is explaining to the chief captain of the army, who is asking about Israel and how to take them down. He runs down our whole history and lets him know the kind of waspness he is about to mess with if it is connected with God: let me tell you about these people.

“And whilst they sinned not before their God, they prospered, because the God that hateth iniquity was with them.” If they are not sinning, they are going to prosper. So their objective is to make sure we don’t keep God’s commandments. They tested us with what sociology calls the Huxtable effect: in the Huxtable years black SAT scores went up, 75 percent of black males graduated high school in 1990, and enrollment at Morehouse went up 37 percent. They monitored it with statistics to see whether we were truly dead or still had a glimmer of trying to do right. Then came the Lil Wayne effect: scores went down, and by 2010 only 47 percent of black males graduated. White men like Edgar Bronfman, worth billions, decide which song goes on the record: the one with the obscenity, not the one with the politics. Then comes murder drill rap, and a 20-year-old doing life in prison: sweat equity.

Nothing out here is for our entertainment. Everything allowed to reach our ears, phones and televisions is sculpted to become a thought, which becomes our actions, which becomes our destiny, so the slaves don’t operate outside the parameters they need them in. Bill Cosby thought he could buy NBC, and they made sure he never saw the light of day again. They have an economic advantage in keeping us docile: their children are guaranteed prosperity from birth to death.

“But when they departed from the way which he appointed them, they were destroyed in many battles very sore”. The they is us. When we depart from God’s commandments it is easy to destroy us, so they must keep us in sin. Think about that: they must keep us in sin. “and were led captives into a land that was not theirs, and the temple of their God was cast to the ground, and their cities were taken by the enemies.”

“But now are they returned to their God, and are come up from the places where they were scattered, and have possessed Jerusalem, where their sanctuary is”. This is the time period when we were allowed to go back and build the temple, Zerubbabel, Nehemiah and Ezra, coming out of the Persian captivity. “for it was desolate”: made desolate by the Babylonians, who came in and razed it even to the ground, the history of Psalms 137.

“Now therefore, my lord and governor”: if there be any error in this people, if they are into sin, into what we are doing now with the 4th of July, this music, evil debauchery, concupiscence, fornication and dope, “and they sin against their God, let us consider that this shall be their ruin, and let us go up, and we shall overcome them.” Let us consider not only the 250 years of sweat equity; let us keep these people as our engine, the fuel to keep our engine going. Even while he is right beside me jumping up and down at the fireworks, he is the oil for the engine. That is what they are celebrating right now.

“But if there be no iniquity in their nation, let my lord now pass by, lest their Lord defend them, and their God be for them, and we become a reproach before all the world.” They don’t want that to happen. The same knowledge persists today: if they can keep us in sin, they can keep exploiting, dominating, robbing and pillaging us, and leave us in a wilderness of foolishness.

So underneath all the fireworks and foolishness of this weekend, how many more Mike Browns, how many more Rasheem Carters and Kendrick Johnsons? How many more abortions, where our women extinguish our children because they feel they have no hope? These things come because we simply don’t keep the commandments of God. We have work to do.

precepts.why:
Before verse 17 comes the question he asks about us: “Tell me now, ye sons of Chanaan, who this people is, that dwelleth in the hill country, and what are the cities that they inhabit”. He says he doesn’t know who we are; he sees us coming out of the Persian captivity and asks why we are not coming to honour him. He needs to know where our strength is, where our power is: “and what is the multitude of their army, and wherein is their power and strength, and what king is set over them, or captain of their army”.

That is what nations do when they want to conquer you: they need to know what held you together as a nation in the first place. That is what they do to us. Once they learn what is vital to us, all they have to do is remove it. What is vital to a man with his family is the man at the door, with the stopping power to make sure you get nowhere near his family; to exploit what is behind the door, you have to take that man out. In our case the strong man is the Bible and our adherence to the Bible. When we stop adhering to the Bible, the strong man is gone, and our goods can be spoiled, robbed, plundered and pillaged.

That is the mission of the Greeks, Columbus’s ancestors: search out everyone’s history, their strengths and their weaknesses, as Alexander did with his library at Alexandria. Josephus records Demetrius, the king’s library keeper, gathering all the books in the habitable earth, and asking for the books of the Jewish legislation, full of hidden wisdom and entirely blameless as the legislation of God, with six elders out of every tribe to interpret them. They know our Bible is a true book; it is not just a book, it is a weapon. The Romans came from the Greeks and Spain from the Romans, and the records were passed down. Assyria moved against the northern kingdom first, and Babylon against the southern kingdom, both knowing that God was against us for our disobedience, because they read our Bible and examine how we are behaving.

sense.text: This is the psychology of how we got to this country. “Those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land in the time of Osea the king, whom Salmanasar the king of Assyria led away captive, and he carried them over the waters, and so came they into another land.” Assyria is before Babylon and before the Persians. Assyria moved against the northern kingdom and took it into captivity in Assyria; Babylon took down Assyria, took Assyria’s captives, and moved down and put Judah in captivity, so all twelve tribes were in captivity under the Babylonians. Then the Persians came in under Cyrus. So we were in captivity in Assyria, and that history is also read in the book of Kings. The they that came into another land is the Israelites.

“But they took this counsel among themselves”. A whole lot of history lies between these two verses: they jump from Assyria to Persia, and nothing of Babylon in between is mentioned. The counsel is about going back to Jerusalem to build, in the time of Persia under Cyrus. “that they would leave the multitude of the heathen, and go forth into a further country, where never mankind dwelt”: the bulk of the tribes said, we are not going to do this; we are not staying in Jerusalem; we are going into a further country.

“That they might there keep their statutes, which they never kept in their own land.” Columbus read this, and he knew the Israelites were here. It is in his log and in the history books: Lost Tribes and Promised Lands has a chapter called Enter Columbus that tells of the records he carried with him about where the Israelites were. He knew the northern kingdom was here, Gad and Reuben and those tribes, before he sailed out.

“And they entered into Euphrates by the narrow passages of the river.” That is the Euphrates by the Tigris, Babylon, Iraq. “For the most High then shewed signs for them, and held still the flood, till they were passed over.”

“For through that country there was a great way to go, namely, of a year and a half”. If it took us a year and a half to get from one area to another, we were making stops. Maritime means things connected with the sea, the oceans and navigation: shipping, commerce, coasts. The Red Sea and the Indian Ocean connected Africa to the wider world, trading with Arabia, India, Persia and China. We were running those ports, or had understanding with the nations we passed. Solomon had a navy in that same region, so it was no mystery for us to make it from Persia over to the Americas: the ports were there. We really had our stuff together.

“and the same region is called Arsareth.” The historians call it a mythical region. It is not mythical. Why would the Bible put a mythical region in it? It is the utmost insult to our intelligence, from the same people who have us celebrating the 4th of July when we were in slavery, Easter bunnies and eggs, Christmas trees and December 25th. Their own description says it is another land a year and a half’s journey beyond the Euphrates, where the ten lost tribes migrated and will dwell until the end of time. The Jewish Encyclopedia says it outright: according to 4 Esdras 13:45, Columbus identified America with this land. The fourth book of Ezra is 2 Esdras: Ezra and Nehemiah are the first two, 1 Esdras the third, 2 Esdras the fourth, all the same history.

That is why, in the film of 1492, Columbus is asked how he can be so certain of the distance west across the ocean when nobody has done it, names the calculations of the mariners and then Esdras, and is told: Esdras is a Jew; two minutes, and already you are a dead man. He was not out there floating in the wind. He read the Bible, he knew exactly what he was looking for, the twelve tribes of Israel, and he used it to locate the tribes in order to exploit and dominate us into being slaves. The records were passed down from the Greeks and kept among themselves. They don’t make movies for our entertainment; they are measuring whether we are waking up.

The records prove it. James Adair, a trader resident among the Indians forty years, wrote in proof of the American Indians being descended from the Jews: their division into tribes, their worship of Jehovah, their theocracy, the ministration of angels, daily sacrifices, prophets and high priests, the law of uncleanness, cities of refuge, raising seed to a deceased brother. One tribe called itself Canaai, after Canaan. And the Spanish explorers of the southern United States, 1528 to 1543, record a native guide saying his ancestors had made war on them, but the sorcerers of his tribe perceived they were a special people and warned they should be left alone, the same warning Achior gave Holofernes. The God of these children of Israel is the true God, everything on their tablets is true, and at the end of days they will be lords of all the nations of the earth. One nation would come bringing many things to this land: Judah, on the slave ships, to give the rest of the tribes back their heritage. And these children of Israel will go forth and reign over the whole earth as they once did.

precepts.why:
The counsel is in Ezra, and it is Cyrus speaking: “Who is there among you of all his people? his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of the Lord God of Israel”. That was the proclamation made between the Most High and Cyrus: Israel allowed to go back and build, in exchange for his being able to take down Babylon.

“And whosoever remaineth in any place where he sojourneth, let the men of his place help him with silver, and with gold, and with goods, and with beasts, beside the freewill offering for the house of God that is in Jerusalem.” That is what was charged to Israel to go and do.

Ezra and 2 Esdras are the same Ezra, two parts of the same history. The counsel the ten tribes took among themselves was over this charge: instead of staying to build in Jerusalem, they would leave the multitude of the heathen and go forth into a further country.

Solomon had a navy of ships. “And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Ezion–geber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red sea, in the land of Edom.” Ezion-geber lies at the northern tip of the Red Sea’s Gulf of Aqaba, by modern Aqaba in Jordan and Eilat. “And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, shipmen that had knowledge of the sea”: those are the maritime men, with knowledge of the sea, “with the servants of Solomon.”

“And they came to Ophir, and fetched from thence gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to king Solomon.” Ophir is not far from that area, and that area is very near where the brothers entered into the Euphrates. So in Solomon’s time we already had maritime trade going, and the year and a half to Arsareth was made through those ports. Ivan Van Sertima, in They Came Before Columbus, spoke of Solomon’s ships coming over here. The lands were promised: they entered into the Euphrates in the first place because they knew this land was for them.

“I will make a man more precious than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.” We often read this and keep going without asking what the gold of Ophir is. It is an exceptionally fine, pure gold, prized in the ancient world, the gold Solomon and Hiram of Tyre brought in on those ships, and its place is called one of history’s greatest mysteries. That is what the Most High is going to make us men: that pure fine gold.
